locked_rule: Report every prespecified event family, including unsupported and non-estimable events.
Report E0/E1 demotions, negative-control failures, false E promotions, false E demotions and missed prespecified positives.
Report artifact-suspected and artifact-dominated outcomes separately if both are implemented before activation.
Report all excluded blocks/samples and the rule that triggered exclusion.
Do not replace, rename or add a primary event family after outcome unmasking.
Exclude a sample only for a prespecified data-integrity or minimum-quality rule; never for an unfavorable TED/outcome result.
Fail closed as not estimable when fewer than three independent biological blocks remain.
Fail closed when condition is completely confounded with batch or no defensible null exists.
Do not treat cells, time bins, technical replicates or pseudo-blocks as independent biological blocks.
Record SHA-256 hashes for locked RNA/activity outputs and the unopened outcome file before outcome access.
Retain the pre-unmasking manifest and every failed gate in the final public archive.
